source_integrity.summary: The staged EN/PT manuscripts and pending JSON have exact SHA-pinned Git blobs on main; no post-approval source mutation allowed.

schema_and_taxonomy.summary: v2 daily-global-macro, English-first, canonical dimensions and controlled macro program/phenomena/format checked.

source_vintage_and_cutoff.summary: Nov 11 00:35 BRT cutoff. All factual Nov10 market closes and release dates observed. Nov12 Brazil IPCA and Nov13 US PPI marked future. No Nov11 Asian quote invented.

factual_methodology.summary: BLS Oct CPI +0.4/core +0.3, missing October 2025 12-month comparison explicitly preserved; Treasury Nov9 2Y4.56/10Y4.88 and Nov10 2Y4.73/10Y4.98/30Y5.35; B3 171336.99 -0.52; BCB reference IPCA 2026 5.6, 2027 4.7, Q2 2028 3.5; EIA Oct spot average 124 and 2026/27 annual forecasts 97/86.

evidence_traceability.summary: 20 cited URLs on 13 hosts with BLS, Treasury, BCB, B3, EIA, Fed, Eurostat, Bank of England and NBS primary data; Reuters/AP supporting consensus and session context. Forecasts are not independently re-estimated, shipping tracking not audited.

research_depth.summary: English 2848 words and Brazilian Portuguese 2931 words, nine ordered analytic sections advancing a single inflation-rates-real economy thesis; documented country-specific mechanisms and counterexamples.

visual_evidence_readiness.summary: 3 quantitative charts per locale with exact numeric series parity, at least one dated evidence table, one two-channel causal flow and six-region comparison map, deterministic grammar.

bilingual_equivalence.summary: 20 references in matching numerical order; matching charts, identical dates, scenarios and limitations; translations preserve distinction between official annual missing data and market estimates.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Prose has no internal QA, build, staged or first-person publication narration; factual assertions distinguish measurement from inference, political attribution and conditional scenarios.

contrary_evidence.summary: Lower Oct monthly CPI than Sep yet CPI above consensus; annual unavailable; Nov10 equities down but week up; EIA longer forecast compiled before latest futures price; Brazil exporter-vs-importer FX effects.

counterfactual_review.summary: Four scenarios with explicit disconfirming evidence and no fabricated probabilities or physical delivery milestones.

pipeline_validation.summary: Assistant check of required schema, word count, sources/hosts, chart parity and visuals; npm build/site deployment requires separate GitHub Actions result.

contrary_evidence: Monthly CPI is below September even though above consensus and core remains elevated; year-on-year official October missing due absent 2025 base.
US equities remain positive for the week despite Nov10 losses, preventing extrapolation of single session.
Lower daily crude quotations coexist with EIA October average and higher annual projections due different vintages and windows.
Brazil's stronger dollar provides some exporter benefit while increasing local currency costs of imports and external liabilities.
China nominal export strength coexists with PMI below 50.
limitations: No official October 2026 annual US CPI where October 2025 baseline missing.
US yields daily par values differ from intraday Reuters benchmark trade snapshots.
EIA forecast finalised Nov5 released Nov10; no representation as realised forward price.
Brazil IPCA October scheduled Nov12, not observed.
EN/PT research prepared and assistant-led QA reviewed, not independent human approval.
Full production deployment separate from GitHub commit and depends on configured GitHub Actions credentials.
QA checks documented by assistant; no independent human proofreader.
notes: Evidence-based editorial review pinned to exact source and pending Git blob SHAs. Build and domain deployment are separate validation stages.

en.title: Global Macro — Inflation overturns the oil relief rally as US and Brazilian policy stay restrictive
en.deck: The October US CPI surprise reprices global rates as Brazil's Copom warns of persistent risks and EIA distinguishes historical oil shock from recent quotes.
en.regime: Sticky US inflation and Brazilian inflation expectations require restrictive monetary policy despite prospective energy relief; global capital costs and FX remain exposed.
en.key_risk: Official October 2026 12-month CPI unavailable; do not invent y/y or confuse monthly CPI with annual EIA Brent forecasts and financial close prices.
